verdict.rationale: Zero's own MCP server documents bulk archive and bulk delete tools, plus label modification and read/unread marking. That is a first-party bulk archive capability. However, it is exposed as MCP tooling rather than as in-app multi-select of conversations, and no evidence shows labeling or mark-done applied to many threads in one stroke. missing for 10: UI multi-select of conversations, bulk labeling across selected threads, a mark-done action, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke
